verdict.rationale: Lorikeet is a customer-service AI SaaS platform, so official SDKs are a fair axis to ask about. The evidence documents only an official MCP server, Claude skills and an llms.txt file. None of these is an official SDK (a client library in a programming language), so they do not count toward this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
